claims.hypothesis: Do SDP.9 and SDP.11 host obscured AGN?
claims.experiment: Chandra ACIS-S observations and spectral fitting
claims.result: Both detected with 14 counts; X-ray luminosity factor 3-4.5 above star-formation expectation
claims.finding: Highly obscured nuclear activity is likely present

evidence.quote: Both the targets were detected in the X-ray, strongly indicating the presence of highly obscured nuclear activity.
